title: Reformulation and Equivalence of Bock's Algorithm for Exact Dependency Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2611.00939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bock's algorithm provides a matrix-based alternative to Chu--Liu/Edmonds (CL/E) for exact dependency parsing. We present a reformulation that retains original node and arc identities through component labels, column adjustments, and star-and-bar transfers. In exact arithmetic, we prove operational equivalence to original Bock under matching scan and tie rules, and establish correspondence with corrected Tarjan under a prescribed component schedule. A separate analysis establishes optimal-value equivalence with Dozat-derived CL/E under the stated score and single-root conventions. We integrate reformulated Bock into a biaffine dependency parser and evaluate decoding and structured training on the Penn Treebank and Chinese Treebank. translated_title: Bock算法在精确依存句法分析中的重构与等价性
translated_abstract: Bock算法为精确依存句法分析提供了一种基于矩阵的Chu–Liu/Edmonds（CL/E）替代方案。我们提出了一种重构方法，通过组件标签、列调整以及星-杠转移来保留原始节点和弧的标识。在精确算术下，我们在匹配的扫描与平局规则下证明了其与原始Bock算法的操作等价性，并在规定的组件调度下建立了与修正后的Tarjan算法的对应关系。另一项独立分析在所述的分数与单根约定下，确立了其与Dozat推导的CL/E算法的最优值等价性。我们将重构后的Bock算法集成到双仿射依存分析器中，并在宾夕法尼亚树库和中文树库上评估了解码与结构化训练的表现。这些结果确立了Bock算法作为依存句法分析和结构化训练的另一种精确求解器，同时区分了最优值的相等性与返回树的同一性以及训练轨迹的差异。
tldr: 本文重构了用于精确依存句法分析的矩阵式Bock算法，证明了其与原始Bock算法、修正后的Tarjan算法以及Dozat版CL/E算法的等价性，并将其集成到双仿射依存分析器中，在宾州树库和中文树库上验证了其在解码与结构化训练中的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates the matrix-based Bock algorithm for exact dependency parsing, proves its equivalence to the original Bock, corrected Tarjan, and Dozat-derived CL/E algorithms, and integrates it into a biaffine parser, validating decoding and structured training on the Penn Treebank and Chinese Treebank.
